schema.description: One day of a Garmin watch's daily summary as GarminDB 3.6.7's daily_summary table holds it, through the anam_garmin importer (source garmin). The device's record: values as Garmin wrote them, intensity times in minutes, empty columns absent. Steps and the day's heart rate are not here; they are activity.steps and health.heart-rate-day. A day the watch recorded nothing for is no facet. Its fact time is the day read in Australia/Sydney, whatever zone the watch was in: a London day sits ten hours before its true start on Anam's timeline, and effective_time_frame says where it truly began. The guard keeps a type's fact-time rule, so card 195's activity.day.garmin is where the fact time moves to the interval start (anam card 197).

id.description: "day:" and daily_summary.day. The identity. Under one source no two types share an id: a facet's id is the source plus its identity values, without the type.

day.description: daily_summary.day: Garmin Connect's calendarDate, the watch's local date. The fact time, read as Sydney midnight; effective_time_frame is the day Garmin counted.

step_goal.description: daily_summary.step_goal: the day's step goal Garmin set.

moderate_activity_minutes.description: daily_summary.moderate_activity_time in minutes: moderate intensity minutes.

vigorous_activity_minutes.description: daily_summary.vigorous_activity_time in minutes: vigorous intensity minutes.

intensity_time_goal_minutes.description: daily_summary.intensity_time_goal in minutes: the week's intensity minutes goal as Garmin shows it that day.

floors_up.description: daily_summary.floors_up: floors climbed, as Garmin estimates them, fractions kept.

distance_km.description: daily_summary.distance: distance covered on foot, in kilometres as GarminDB writes it.

calories_goal.description: daily_summary.calories_goal: the day's calorie goal, in kilocalories.

calories_total.description: daily_summary.calories_total: kilocalories burned in the day, Garmin's estimate.

calories_bmr.description: daily_summary.calories_bmr: the resting share of calories_total.

calories_active.description: daily_summary.calories_active: the active share of calories_total.

hydration_goal.description: daily_summary.hydration_goal: the day's fluid goal, in millilitres.

sweat_loss.description: daily_summary.sweat_loss: Garmin's estimated sweat loss, in millilitres.

stress_avg.description: daily_summary.stress_avg: Garmin's average stress for the day, 0 to 100; Garmin writes a negative number when it had too little data, and that is kept as written.

spo2_avg.description: daily_summary.spo2_avg: average blood oxygen saturation, in percent.

spo2_min.description: daily_summary.spo2_min: lowest blood oxygen saturation, in percent.

rr_waking_avg.description: daily_summary.rr_waking_avg: average waking respiration rate, breaths per minute.

rr_max.description: daily_summary.rr_max: highest respiration rate, breaths per minute.

rr_min.description: daily_summary.rr_min: lowest respiration rate, breaths per minute.

bb_charged.description: daily_summary.bb_charged: body battery charged during the day, Garmin's 0 to 100 scale.

effective_time_frame.description: The day Garmin counted, as an OMH time interval: Garmin Connect's own start and end, each RFC 3339 at the offset the watch was at then. A day the watch crossed zones in has two offsets (17 October 2026 runs +11:00 to +01:00, 34 hours); a day still in progress ends where Garmin had counted to. The start is where the day began; until card 195 the fact time is the date's Sydney midnight instead.

start_date_time.description: RFC 3339, the day's local midnight at the watch's offset.

end_date_time.description: RFC 3339, the next local midnight at the watch's offset, or where Garmin had counted to.

source_time.description: How Garmin's day was read (card 197): value is its date as Garmin Connect files it, read in the offset the day began at (basis source); a day Garmin gave no interval for is read in Australia/Sydney instead (basis assumption), and the importer logs it.

value.description: The fact time as the source supplied it, as text and never rewritten: a date, a wall clock, an RFC 3339 string, or an epoch as its digits.

zone.description: The zone value is read in, and nothing else: an IANA name when one is known, UTC for a value that is UTC, else a fixed offset +HH:MM or -HH:MM. The gate refuses a name that is no zone.

basis.description: Who decided the zone. source: the source supplied it with the value, or the value is UTC by the source's own definition. configuration: a setting a person made for this source names it. assumption: the importer or writer chose it, with nothing behind it but its own default or the Definition's zone, and logged that it did.
